protocol_overview.type: Host-centric tiered-star serial bus; polled (host initiates all transfers).
protocol_overview.duplex_high_speed: half-duplex (same wires, but with high-speed signaling mode)

functional_requirements.text: Two-wire differential signaling on D+ / D-; pull-up resistor on D+ (full-speed) or D- (low-speed) of the device identifies device speed at attach.
NRZI encoding with bit stuffing: 0 = change-of-state on the line, 1 = no-change; insert a 0 bit after 6 consecutive 1s to provide guaranteed transitions for receiver clock recovery.
Three signaling speeds: Low-speed 1.5 Mb/s, Full-speed 12 Mb/s, High-speed 480 Mb/s. High-speed uses chirped handshake at attach to negotiate.
Tiered-star topology, host-centric: 1 host + up to 5 levels of hubs + up to 127 devices; all transactions initiated by the host.
Three packet kinds: Token (host-issued: IN / OUT / SETUP / SOF), Data (DATA0 / DATA1 / DATA2 / MDATA), Handshake (ACK / NAK / STALL / NYET / NRDY).

Four transfer types — Control (bidirectional, used for enumeration + standard requests), Interrupt (small-data bounded-latency), Bulk (large-data best-effort), Isochronous (periodic guaranteed-bandwidth, no retry).
Communication abstraction = pipe: association between an endpoint on a device and software on host. Stream pipes carry raw data; message pipes carry request/data/status (used for Control transfers).
Endpoint = unique addressable resource on a device; identified by endpoint number (4 bits) + direction (IN / OUT). Endpoint 0 is the default control endpoint; always present.
Frame = 1 ms time base on FS/LS bus; Microframe = 125 µs on HS bus. SOF packet at start of each (micro)frame includes 11-bit frame number.
Bus enumeration: host detects connect, resets device, assigns address 1..127, queries descriptors, configures device.
VBUS = +5 V (host or hub provides). Bus-powered devices draw ≤ 100 mA unconfigured, ≤ 500 mA configured. Self-powered devices draw ≤ 100 mA at power-on for enumeration.
Token / SOF packets use CRC-5 over data fields; Data packets use CRC-16 over data field. Polynomials: CRC5 = x^5 + x^2 + 1; CRC16 = x^16 + x^15 + x^2 + 1.
Data toggle synchronization between host and endpoint: each successful transaction toggles DATA0 ↔ DATA1; corrupted or unaccepted transactions repeat with same toggle; SETUP token forces DATA0.
USB Reset: host drives D+ and D- to single-ended-zero (SE0) for ≥ 10 ms; device returns to default state and address 0.
USB Suspend: bus idle for > 3 ms forces all downstream devices into suspend; device draws ≤ 500 µA from VBUS in suspend.
Remote wakeup: a suspended device with remote-wakeup feature enabled can drive K-state (resume) on the upstream port to wake the bus.
Split transactions: USB 2.0 host + hub may issue Start-Split + Complete-Split to a HS hub that talks at FS/LS to legacy downstream devices, preserving HS bandwidth.

error_response_conditions: Bit-stuff violation (7 consecutive 1s without a stuffed 0)
CRC error (CRC-5 on token / CRC-16 on data)
Timeout — receiver did not respond within bus-turn-around time
Babble — device transmits past end of (micro)frame
Loss of bus activity (LOA) — SOP without corresponding EOP
STALL handshake — endpoint halt condition; requires explicit ClearFeature(ENDPOINT_HALT) to recover
compliance_requirements: Backward compatibility with USB 1.1 devices on the same bus.
Hubs must implement Transaction Translator (TT) when bridging HS upstream to FS/LS downstream.
Maximum cable length: 5 m (FS) / 3 m (LS) per segment.
Maximum end-to-end signal delay: 26 ns per cable + 4 ns per hub tier.
Endpoint 0 must support GET_DESCRIPTOR(Device), SET_ADDRESS, and SET_CONFIGURATION.
